Engineering, BHT, BAT from government recognised institution); or Graduation in Science (BSc); or Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture; B.Tech in Agriculture Engineering; BVSc & AH from a Government recognized institution) Age limit: 21 to 45 years (as of the last date of submission) | Other conditions: | Must make available space of two rooms/shops (approx. 750 to 800 Sq. Ft.) on own, with no rent claimed Weekly reporting to Panchayat, Block and Line departments is mandatory Works on franchise-franchisee basis under supervision of a Designated APD Officer | Desirable: | Post-graduation (science/agri & allied) Computer diploma/certification of 3 or more months from a government recognised institution

salary_details.pay_scale: No fixed pay; engagement on self-earning/entrepreneur basis (service charges, input sales commission, B2B/B2C marketing commission, contingency fee for training)

how_to_apply: Obtain the application form (Annexure A) and detailed information from the office of Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua 184101.
Fill the prescribed application form and affix latest passport size photograph with white background.
Attach self-attested photocopies of date of birth, marks, domicile and character certificates.
Attach affidavit attested by 1st Class Magistrate on providing two rooms/shops space and the declaration (Annexure B).
Submit to the office of the Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua in person or through registered post by 25-11-2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected without further notice Postal delay is not the responsibility of the APD/advertising authority APD reserves the right to change or add any condition at the time of signing the agreement

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields (Diploma in Agriculture, Horticulture, Veterinary Sciences, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture, Agri. Engineering, BHT, BAT from government recognised institution); or Graduation in Science (BSc); or Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, Sericulture; B.Tech in Agriculture Engineering; BVSc & AH from a Government recognized institution) Age limit: 21 to 45 years (as of the last date of submission) Other conditions: Must make available space of two rooms/shops (approx. 750 to 800 Sq. Ft.) on own, with no rent claimed Weekly reporting to Panchayat, Block and Line departments is mandatory Works on franchise-franchisee basis under supervision of a Designated APD Officer Desirable: Post-graduation (science/agri & allied) Computer diploma/certification of 3 or more months from a government recognised institution

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Self-earning/entrepreneur basis: income from service charges, commission on input sales, B2B/B2C marketing commission and contingency fee for training. Initially two years, with possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of scheme Refundable security of Rs 10,000 as Fixed Deposit Receipt from any scheduled commercial bank Undertaking to stay minimum two years; security of INR 10,000 forfeited on exit before two years Agreement may be terminated by either party with 3-month prior notice No right to claim any regular appointment

content_sections.heading: How Will DC Kathua Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Point-based system (maximum 100 points) Document verification of shortlisted candidates Publication of list of selected candidates Agreement signing with Agriculture Production Department Domicile of Local Panchayat: 25 points; Female candidates: 05 points Highest-scoring eligible candidates considered; shortlisted candidates undergo document verification with originals Selected list published on official websites of the District and Agriculture Production Department

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth certificate (Matriculation certificate) Marks certificate of all qualifying examinations Domicile Certificate Character certificate issued by competent authority Affidavit attested by a 1st Class Magistrate on providing space of two rooms/shops Declaration on notarized affidavit (Annexure B)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DC Kathua Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form (Annexure A) and detailed information from the office of Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua 184101. Fill the prescribed application form and affix latest passport size photograph with white background. Attach self-attested photocopies of date of birth, marks, domicile and character certificates. Attach affidavit attested by 1st Class Magistrate on providing two rooms/shops space and the declaration (Annexure B). Submit to the office of the Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua in person or through registered post by 25-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected without further notice Postal delay is not the responsibility of the APD/advertising authority APD reserves the right to change or add any condition at the time of signing the agreement

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DC Kathua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DC Kathua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Krishi Udyami (KU) (Agricultural Entrepreneur).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DC Kathua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure A of this notice; also obtainable from the office of Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua) and send it to Office of the Chief Agriculture Officer, Kathua 184101, by in person or through registered post, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years (as of the last date of submission).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No fixed pay; engagement on self-earning/entrepreneur basis (service charges, input sales commission, B2B/B2C marketing commission, contingency fee for training).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma in Agriculture & Allied Fields or Graduation in Science (BSc), Graduation in Agriculture and Allied Fields (BSc/BVSc); additional preference for post-graduation (science/agri & allied) and computer diplomas/certifications.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must make available space of two rooms/shops (approx. 750 to 800 Sq. Ft.) on own, with no rent claimed. Weekly reporting to Panchayat, Block and Line departments is mandatory. Works on franchise-franchisee basis under supervision of a Designated APD Officer.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Point-based system (maximum 100 points). Document verification of shortlisted candidates. Publication of list of selected candidates. Agreement signing with Agriculture Production Department.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially two years, with possibility of annual extensions subject to satisfactory performance and continuation of scheme. Refundable security of Rs 10,000 as Fixed Deposit Receipt from any scheduled commercial bank. Undertaking to stay minimum two years; security of INR 10,000 forfeited on exit before two years.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kisan Khidmat Ghar, Village/Panchayat Dhanuparole, Cluster Dhanuparole & Goduflal, Block Duggain, Sub-Division Billawar, District Kathua.
